purpose: Figure-ready source data for the four surviving claims of the v2 line, each with the specification that produced it. Every number is read from a committed result JSON; the JSONs' sha256 prefixes are recorded so a figure can be traced to its artifact.

excluded.anatomy/RESULT_icc_INVALID.json: WITHdrawn: the within-animal variance was computed as var(vs) if len(vs)>1 else 0, and most (animal,pair) units hold one measurement, so the ICC of 0.93 is inflated by construction.
excluded.anatomy/RESULT_iv_weighting_INVALID_weig: Withdrawn: the inverse-variance weights span thirty-one orders of magnitude, so the weighted mean is determined by a handful of near-zero-variance units.

V2-C1_unit_inflation.claim: Treating neuron-pair measurements as independent replicates inflates the standardised connectivity-function effect by 11 to 18 times.
V2-C1_unit_inflation.figure: paired bar chart, one bar per unit, three contrast panels (chemical, gap, combined)

pair_unit_counterpart.note: from CONFOUND_TESTS round 5; the committed JSON for that run is RESULT_corrected.json

specification.readout: connected mean minus unconnected mean, each animal standardised within itself
specification.analysis_window: per event, int((inter-stimulus interval - 5)/dt), capped at 60 volumes

V2-C2_fig6_reproduction.claim: The source's own anatomy-versus-spontaneous-activity comparison reproduces, and the quantity it predicts has cross-animal agreement of only r = 0.208 on the cells available.
V2-C2_fig6_reproduction.figure: two panels: the two animals' Fig-6 values; the cross-animal agreement of the target

specification.target: off-diagonal activity correlation matrix per animal
specification.predictor: synapse-count matrix built by name from both source tables, 346 names

V2-C3_three_level_decomposition.claim: A pair's response decomposes into 55.1 % between-pair, 37.5 % within-cell measurement error, 5.5 % pair-specific animal deviation and 1.9 % homogeneous animal offset.
V2-C3_three_level_decomposition.figure: single stacked bar of the four variance shares

specification.identification: eps from the units with repeats; the rest by subtraction
specification.space: log, because the responses span -3.5e5 to 2.5e5

V2-C4_specification_sensitivity.claim: The published per-pair values come from analysis choices that live in the pipeline's code and not in its data file, and re-analysing the same records under defensible choices moves the animal-level estimate from d = 0.085 to 0.729.
V2-C4_specification_sensitivity.figure: one point per specification on a common axis, with the animal unit and the pair unit marked

series.spec: 4 s window, common-mode removed, no inclusion rule

series.source: 12_inverse_variance_weighting.py (the unweighted arm only; the weighted arm is INVALID)

V2-C4_specification_sensitivity.validation_of_the_range: The range is an instance of a condition the field reports: a 2025 Nature Reviews Neuroscience review states it remains unclear whether structural connectivity constrains directed-connectivity models, and a 2025 Scientific Reports paper states no universally accepted method exists for inferring effective connectivity.

supporting_reliability.figure: two panels: split-half reliability by stratum; the variance shares of the effect

withdrawn_or_narrowed.was: the animals differ rather than the measurements being noisy (round 9)
withdrawn_or_narrowed.now: narrowed in round 12: 5.5 % pair-specific animal against 37.5 % measurement error

withdrawn_or_narrowed.was: a population-level regularity rather than a circuit property (round 10)
withdrawn_or_narrowed.now: weakened in round 12; the between-animal spread is 42.2 % noise and 17.7 % pair composition
